Based on the chest X-ray findings in Figure 1, which of the following statements best describes the relationship between the pleural thickening and the soft tissue swelling in the left middle lung zone?
A) The pleural thickening is inferior and extends medially to the soft tissue swelling, suggesting a direct involvement of the pleura with the rib lesion.
B) The pleural thickening and the soft tissue swelling are separate findings with no apparent direct anatomical relationship.
C) The pleural thickening is superior and lateral to the soft tissue swelling, indicating possible pleural effusion as a result of rib lesion.
D) The pleural thickening is directly overlying the soft tissue swelling, suggesting a potential extension of the rib lesion into the pleura.
E) The pleural thickening is anterior to the soft tissue swelling, suggesting a secondary pleural reaction.
F) The pleural thickening and soft tissue swelling are equally distributed, indicating a generalized inflammatory process.
